title: Predict the next CPU burst
summary: Exponential averaging: tau(n+1) = alpha * t(n) + (1 - alpha) * tau(n).
hints: Keep a `double tau`. For each real burst `t`: print the current `tau` as the estimate for that burst, then update `tau = alpha * t + (1 - alpha) * tau`.
After the last burst print the estimate for the burst that has not happened yet (`next`). Use `%.2f`.
